scope: All 16 clean-source outputs of a newly opened test-assigned chapter slice, labels frozen before generation; not a production app-use failure estimate

entries.note: The omitted greeting is restored, but the literal N-agradable conocerte remains defective Spanish; this is not counted as a complete usable-dialogue correction.
The abbreviated named spell translation needs terminology context; do not manufacture a confirmed error by enforcing a literal title match.

The isolated English does not identify speaker gender; the male article alone cannot establish a model error.
HOT GUY is still translated as a temperature/sexual literal rather than attractiveness.
PARTY means an adventuring group; the political party and celebration readings are both wrong.
The meaningful NOT EVEN LOOKING is retained. The filler and character speech suffix are excluded from content-loss counts.
The men/adventurer-friends self-repair remains awkward, but both meaningful terms and the inability to find them are present; filler omission is not counted as a new content loss.

reason_not_promoted: The newly opened test remains imperfect, and the old control exposes new meaning/quality regressions; do not replace the installed model on a small average improvement.
